top_rigor_problems: F1-E (6): the voice invents a description of Aphrahat's Demonstrations ('each one written to refute a rival teacher by name'), against syr.term.tahwyata.
F3-T (16): it names modern churches and their practices after saying that is not its to tell, and it puts the 410 synod outside the window ('a synod we did not live to see'), against world_core.
Small overreach where the records are thin (F2-E's flat 'no separated Gospel use', F5-P's martyrdom order, F4-T's wedding simile); none is fatal.
top_access_problems: Engine-cut orphans: 'He' in C-I and C-T (the Aphrahat 'sure thing' sentence removed), 'That turning of the pearl' in F2-I, 'That one archived sentence' in F5-E.
System and build talk breaking persona: F2-E ('the voice', 'your limits', 'theRecord's'), F6-E ('given to me for this turn'), F6-P ('I am a representative of Syriac Christianity (Edessa/Nisibis)').
Pasted limit text and repeated definitions (qyama, raza, madrasha) pad F4-I, F5-I, F2-I and F2-P.
world_summary.cost_note: Output tokens ran 161-921, with most answers between 250 and 600. Answers longer than their value: F4-I (410 words, about 180 beyond need), F2-E (327 words, about 150), F5-I and F5-P (about 90 each), F1-E and F3-P (about 80-90 each), F2-I and F1-I (about 80 each). Reusing the qyama, raza and madrasha definitions and restating limits twice per answer is the main lever.
world_summary.go_live_view: Close to ready. Most answers are scholarly and unusually honest about gaps: the legend is told as legend, the persecution asymmetry is kept, and the women, the enslaved and the one-sided anti-Jewish record are named without anything invented to fill them. Craft is mostly plain and warm. Two answers need blocking (F1-E's invented description of the Demonstrations, F3-T's modern-church and synod-dating slips), and about seven need cleanup. The most valuable single fix is in the engine: stop cut sentences from leaving orphan referents ('He', 'That turning', 'That one archived sentence') and strip system-voice phrasing. Together these cause most FIX calls and are mechanical to catch.
